df_prod = sources["production_today_1"]

# Group by standard product keys and aggregate PRODUCTION sum
grain_cols = ["TECH", "DENSITY", "MODE", "PKG1", "PKG2", "LEAD", "MCP_NO"]
existing_grain_cols = [c for c in grain_cols if c in df_prod.columns]

if "PRODUCTION" in df_prod.columns and existing_grain_cols:
    agg_df = df_prod.groupby(existing_grain_cols, dropna=False)["PRODUCTION"].sum().reset_index()
    
    # Sort by PRODUCTION desc and get top 5
    result = agg_df.sort_values(by="PRODUCTION", ascending=False).head(5)
    
    # Ensure required columns are present and clean up dimension nulls
    required_cols = ["TECH", "DENSITY", "MODE", "PKG1", "PKG2", "LEAD", "MCP_NO", "PRODUCTION"]
    for col in required_cols:
        if col not in result.columns:
            result[col] = ""
            
    for col in existing_grain_cols:
        result[col] = result[col].fillna("").astype(str).str.replace(r"^\s*$", "", regex=True)
        
    result["PRODUCTION"] = result["PRODUCTION"].fillna(0)
    
    final_cols = [c for c in required_cols if c in result.columns]
    result = result[final_cols]
else:
    result = pd.DataFrame(columns=["TECH", "DENSITY", "MODE", "PKG1", "PKG2", "LEAD", "MCP_NO", "PRODUCTION"])
